changed_method: Exact cover on all possible n-window tiles; literal (n-1)-overlap vertex balance; inspect connectedness and recover an Euler tour if connected.
rationale: The initial eight finite tests failed. All four n8d2 frame classes admit balanced tile partitions, while all four surviving n8d3 classes fail even tiling. Literal cyclic gluing is therefore a separate kernel at d2.
benchmarks: Pinned source n4d1 and n8d1 must recover a connected Euler tour and pass literal expansion; flipped n4 word must be UNSAT.
one_changed_constructive_test: binary n12d3 with pane ...* repeated three times, the only binary n12 frame type allowed by source restrictions
n12_justification: Only after new tiling-versus-gluing evidence and a different encoding with 2048 tile selectors instead of global-position XORs. No enlargement of initial mask time caps.
stop_rule: Record SAT graph components or checked UNSAT/unknown. No repeated cap increases. A connected SAT graph must yield an independently literally verified upcycle; any other result leaves the original unresolved.
